instruction.text: Read the text and answer the questions.

atoms.text: “China is pretty cool,” admitted Coto to himself. don’t get it wrong, he is still upset about spending 8 weeks in Jiangxi Province. All his friends are going to be having fun without him in the summer holidays, while he is stuck in China taking language courses. Lessons in summer: how much worse could it get?

All his friends are going to be having fun without him in the summer holidays, while he is stuck in China taking language courses. Lessons in summer: how much worse could it get?

atoms.text: But then again, he is spending all of his extra time hiking and exploring the mountains with his parents who are working there. He also made friends with a boy in a different class. They meet during breaks and play football together. His name is Bolin. He even gets to go to Bolin’s house for dinner sometimes. His grandmother makes everything from scratch. It’s amazing! Bolin also has a one-year-old sister, Mai, who Coto likes too. So, Coto has to say, there are perks to being in Jiangxi.

atoms.a: What does Coto dislike about being in China?
atoms.sound: What does Kohtoh dislike about being in China?
b: Coto dislikes all the delicious food and the beautiful scenery.
++Coto dislikes missing the summer holidays and taking a language course.

atoms.a: What does Coto enjoy about being in China?
atoms.sound: What does Kohtoh enjoy about being in China?
b: ++Coto enjoys hiking and exploring the mountains and spending time with his new friend Bolin.
Coto likes taking a language class and doing all of his chores.

atoms.text:
The next day at school, Bolin didn’t want to play. “What’s wrong Bolin?” asked Coto. At first, it seemed like Bolin didn’t want to talk about it. Coto shrugged and reached for his book to sit next to Bolin and keep him company.
But then, “My grandmother is really upset. A small piece of jade, a family heirloom given to her by her grandmother and said to have been in the family for generations, has gone missing. She also said it holds our family’s luck!”
Bolin seemed anxious and upset. “She says she won’t cook any family recipes until it has returned!” Bolin looked at Coto and said, “You have tasted her food, you know how terrible this is!”

hint.text: An heirloom is an object passed down for generations within a family, that often carries emotional value.
hint.label: Heirloom

atoms.text:
Coto looked at his friend and said, “We are going to figure this out!” Bolin looked surprised.
“We will? How can we possibly do that?” he asked disbelievingly.
“With good detective work!” answered Coto. Finally, another case!

atoms.a: Choose the statement that correctly contrasts Coto’s and Bolin’s reactions to the missing family heirloom.
atoms.sound: Choose the statement that correctly contrasts Kohtoh’s and Bow-lin’s reactions to the missing family heirloom.
atoms.hint: When we contrast, we find what makes two or more things different.
b: ++Bolin is upset, while Coto is excited to solve another mystery.
Coto is sad and frustrated, while Bolin does not seem to care.

atoms.a: What upsets Bolin the most about the missing heirloom?
atoms.sound: What upsets Bow-lin the most about the missing heirloom?
b: that it might have been stolen
++that his grandma won’t cook until it is back
